purpose: Determine whether the Python-based regime/strategy modules satisfy the intended C++/ObjC++/Metal/Python architecture, measuring actual workload before proposing any migration.

intended_language_boundaries.python: orchestration, provider integration, research, configuration, persistence

actual_native_surface.metal_kernels_dir: metal/*.metal (covariance, reductions, imbalance, indicators, monte-carlo, technical_indicators, market_breadth, opportunity_screening, opportunity_ranking)

python_regime_strategy_modules.what_they_do: Deterministic condition gates + light per-scope aggregation over feature rows that are ALREADY produced by the native/Metal screen. regime_engine reuses amps_v4_regime.directional_score (fed by native technical_features) and the GPU market_breadth snapshot; family evaluators mirror the native screen_market SCREEN_ENTRY_QUALIFIED contract.
heavy_numerics_delegated_to_native: technical feature computation (native TechFeatures / Metal technical_indicators)
screening / entry qualification (native ScreeningOutput / Metal opportunity_screening)
economic/opportunity ranking kernels (native rank_scores / Metal opportunity_ranking)
python_regime_strategy_modules.python_only_math: O(symbols) mean/sum aggregation of a handful of benchmark reference rows and per-dimension threshold comparisons; no matrix math, no per-tick loops.

measured_workload.benchmark: RegimeStrategyPipeline.run() over fully-populated feature rows (5 families each)
measured_workload.note: The advisory pass is scheduled off the market-ingestion / protective-exit hot path; one full-universe pass every 15s consumes ~1.3% wall-clock.

conclusion.verdict: PYTHON PLACEMENT IS CORRECT — NO C++ MIGRATION WARRANTED
conclusion.rationale: The regime/strategy layer is lightweight orchestration (condition gates + small aggregations) over numerics that are ALREADY native/Metal. A full-universe advisory pass is ~201 ms at ~34 us/symbol, off the hot path. Per directive §5, lightweight orchestration must not be rewritten in C++ without a demonstrated architectural or performance benefit; none exists here.
remaining_native_gaps: NONE blocking certification. The screen/features/breadth/ranking/risk numerics are native; regime/strategy orchestration is appropriately Python.

Optional future work (not required): if the family evaluators ever move to per-tick (sub-second) cadence over the full universe, revisit vectorization or a native screen_market extension; at the current 15s advisory cadence this is unjustified.
